overview: SaaS application for French language compliance management in Quebec (Loi 96 / OQLF Charter of the French Language), styled like high-precision tax preparation software with PRO (Multi-client consultant) and SOLO (Single business guided) modes.

theme.philosophy: Institutional authority meets sleek modern legaltech. Calm, trustworthy, bone-white paper backgrounds, rich deep navy structural elements, and high-visibility status tags for legal deadlines.

primary.name: Bleu Institutionnel Québec
primary.usage: Primary headers, dominant structural bars, key buttons, and brand anchors.

secondary.name: Bleu Azur Légal
secondary.usage: Interactive states, active steps, primary CTA accents, focus rings.

neutral_bg.usage: Application canvas background with subtle grain/paper texture feel.

surface.usage: Form cards, dossier tables, module containers with 1px subtle border.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.legal_code: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 font-medium

welcome_screen.structure: Split high-impact choice matrix. Left side: SOLO (Single company, step-by-step wizard, pre-filled templates). Right side: PRO (Consultant workspace, multi-client partitioning, global compliance timeline).
welcome_screen.cta_style: Hero-grade mode selector cards with feature comparisons and instant account setup.

dashboard.grid: MODE B: High Density Dashboard Grid. Header bar with current client filter (PRO) + stage countdown banner. Main grid with 8-stage visual pipeline, nearest deadline alert card, completion velocity chart, and upcoming OQLF exchanges.
dashboard.pipeline_visualization: 8-stage horizontal stepper with interactive node expansion: 1. Inscription -> 2. Communication OQLF -> 3. Analyse Situation (Mod 1) -> 4. Diagnostic -> 5. Programme (Mod 2) -> 6. Déploiement -> 7. Rapport Annuel -> 8. Certificat.

module_1_forms.structure: Accordion-assisted multi-section tax-style form with 11 standardized sections + Annexes I & II. Sticky sidebar navigation with completion percentage per section and auto-save indicator.
module_1_forms.form_elements: Explicit labels, conditional sub-questions, inline legal tooltips, repeatable personnel/software tables with add/remove rows.

module_2_programme.structure: Catalog of fixed legal themes (Level A: Obligations générales, Level B: Directives spécifiques). Repeatable measures table with target deadlines, responsible roles, and official Loi 96 reference badges.
module_2_programme.read_only_references: Grounded legal callouts with muted parchment/slate tint and lock icon.

audit_log.structure: Immutable timeline journal displaying timestamp, actor, mode (PRO/SOLO), action (Field update, PDF generated, Document attached, Status change), and cryptographic checksum.

components_and_ui.modal_style: Shadcn Dialog customized with deep slate headers and high-contrast action buttons
components_and_ui.data_tables: Density-optimized with sticky header, search filter, status drop-down filter, and pagination
components_and_ui.pdf_preview: Integrated print-ready iframe/view with official Quebec government document header bar, seal emblem placeholder, and page-break visual split

images.description: Bureau professionnel modern avec interface de conformité

testing_and_qa.requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, selects, pipeline nodes, modal triggers, export triggers) MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

universal_instructions: Ensure all text is strictly in French (Quebec terminology: Francisation, OQLF, Analyse de la situation linguistique, Programme de francisation, Journal d'audit).
Never hide essential desktop controls behind mobile drawers unless on small viewports.
Ensure form fields auto-save locally/backend and show subtle animated 'Enregistré à HH:MM' state indicators.
Maintain strict multi-client isolation in PRO mode with clear header badges showing the selected active client company.
Do not use transparent backgrounds under dropdown menus or modals.
